extDescription.message: Locally checks whether the active tab is an official ARGUS provider domain.

notice.message: Visiting a website never confirms that you have an account there.

tabUnreadable.message: ARGUS could not read the active tab URL.

noUrl.message: No active tab URL is available.

notHttps.message: This tab does not use an HTTPS website URL. ARGUS only labels HTTPS pages.

notWebsite.message: This tab does not use a website URL.

notInCatalogue.message: This domain is not in the bundled ARGUS provider catalogue. This says nothing about whether an account exists.

subdomain.message: Subdomain of an ARGUS catalogue domain. Other people may publish pages here; check the address yourself.

noPasswordLink.message: ARGUS has no verified password-management link for this provider. Do not guess one.

passwordLinkAvailable.message: A documented password-management link is available. Opening it does not change anything automatically.

copyBlocked.message: The browser blocked copying. You can open the verified link instead.

catalogueUnreadable.message: The local catalogue could not be read.
